items.title: ‘SpaceX Has Gone All In With Nvidia’: Nvidia’s Biggest Customer Is Also Its Biggest Stock Holding at $19.7B
items.summary: SpaceX can bet big on a single chip supplier because it controls its own financing. Your brokerage account has no such safety net, and NVIDIA's recent slide shows how quickly one concentrated position can drag down an entire portfolio.
